name: DrawBench
description: DrawBench is a comprehensive and challenging benchmark for evaluating text-to-image models, focusing on sample quality and image-text alignment through human rater comparisons.
reputation: Used to compare state-of-the-art text-to-image models including Imagen, VQ-GAN+CLIP, Latent Diffusion Models, and DALL-E 2.
notes: Benchmark emphasizes human preference in side-by-side comparisons for sample quality and image-text alignment.
